requests.prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent pixel-art sprite: true BOTTOM principal view of the exact Ghost Cemetery spirit-box trap, camera looking straight up along -Z. The native object is a vertical stone-framed circular mechanism, with a blue/gold ring on its FRONT face, two top and two bottom corner caps, and only shallow front-to-back thickness established by the accepted side view. From directly below, the front ring face is edge-on and fully occluded; do not show the full square front panel, ring face, or any upright rectangle. Show one narrow horizontal stone bottom rail/underside across the source's full X width, at the same shallow Y footprint as the accepted top candidate, with only the two lower corner-cap undersides visible along that edge and a compact dark backing seam. Preserve source gray/white masonry, gold cap colors, cyan/blue edge material. No square slab, no four-corner face, no floor plane, no extra symbols. Keep the same width as the accepted FRONT and TOP, transparent margin. Strict orthographic pixel-art projection.

Create ONE isolated transparent pixel-art sprite: strict overhead TOP view of the exact El Capitolio entrance facade. Keep the same identity and source gold/teal palette. The previous overhead draft is too shallow: retain the SAME broad-X span and increase only the roof-plan Y depth so the completed footprint depth matches the existing accepted BOTTOM strip and accepted side view; do not stretch or shrink the source along one axis. Make the plan a shallow but complete rectangle, with long X span and Y depth equal to the accepted underside depth (approximately 40% of X, not a thin hairline). The gold dome appears as a circular top cap centered on the roof, with compact palm crowns at the same positions; show roof/cornice surfaces only. No facade columns, windows, doors, upright trunks, or frontal perspective. Camera exactly along +Z, no tilt or isometric. Crisp pixel-art sprite with transparent margin.

Create ONE isolated transparent pixel-art sprite: strict overhead TOP view of the exact Old Havana arcade frontage. Preserve its gold-and-teal roof/coping and exact four rooftop finials and positions. The previous draft was too shallow: keep the SAME long X span and increase the roof footprint's Y depth until it matches the accepted BOTTOM strip and accepted side depth; do not anisotropically distort anything. Make a long shallow rectangle with Y depth about 30% of X, not a narrow line. Show only the horizontal roof/coping top and compact overhead finial facets. No upright balcony, windows, doors, columns, or facade. Strict camera along +Z, no perspective/tilt/isometric, crisp pixel-art with transparent margin.
